row: Volunteer dog videos, Harbor shelter, San Pedro CA

Showing shelter dogs on walks outside their kennels. Most of these dogs only get walked 1-2x/wk due to overcrowding and underfunded conditions. The shelter dog situation in SoCal is dire and good dogs are being euthanized daily. Please visit LA Animal services website to see videos & description of each dog. Harbor Animal shelter is an LA City shelter located in San Pedro, CA.
